headers.name: actual_core_all_bridges
headers.header:
theorem actual_core_all_bridges (k : N.OriginalBlobArc b) :
    (coreGraph N b hg).IsBridge k

headers.name: collapse_opened_tips_injective
headers.header:
theorem collapse_opened_tips_injective
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u ≠ v) :
    Function.Injective (fun t : (M).OpenedTip =>
      collapse N b hg hb ((M).openedTipVertex t))

headers.name: tipPoint_injective
headers.header:
theorem tipPoint_injective (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    Function.Injective (tipPoint N D b hg hb)

headers.name: tip_sourceCarrier_iff
headers.header:
theorem tip_sourceCarrier_iff (k : N.OriginalBlobArc b) (t : (M).OpenedTip) :
    tipPoint N D b hg hb t ∈ sourceCarrier N D b hg k ↔
      (OG).ReachWithout (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k)
        ((OG).source (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k)) ((M).openedTipVertex t)

headers.name: tip_targetCarrier_iff
headers.header:
theorem tip_targetCarrier_iff (k : N.OriginalBlobArc b) (t : (M).OpenedTip) :
    tipPoint N D b hg hb t ∈ targetCarrier N D b hg k ↔
      (OG).ReachWithout (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k)
        ((OG).target (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k)) ((M).openedTipVertex t)

headers.name: actual_cut_carriers
headers.header:
theorem actual_cut_carriers (k : N.OriginalBlobArc b) :
    IsCompact (sourceCarrier N D b hg k) ∧ IsConnected (sourceCarrier N D b hg k) ∧
    IsCompact (targetCarrier N D b hg k) ∧ IsConnected (targetCarrier N D b hg k) ∧
    Disjoint (sourceCarrier N D b hg k) (targetCarrier N D b hg k)

headers.name: actual_cut_carriers_closed_disk
headers.header:
theorem actual_cut_carriers_closed_disk (k : N.OriginalBlobArc b)
    (o : Schoenflies.Plane) (C : Set Schoenflies.Plane)
    (hface : Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b)) o =
      Schoenflies.outside C) :
    sourceCarrier N D b hg k ⊆ C ∪ Schoenflies.inside C ∧
    targetCarrier N D b hg k ⊆ C ∪ Schoenflies.inside C

headers.name: actual_quartet_carrier_membership
headers.header:
theorem actual_quartet_carrier_membership (f : (M).OpenedHybridEdge)
    (a c d e : (M).OpenedTip) (hac : a≠c) (hde : d≠e)
    (hq : (OG).OrientedQuartet f ((M).openedTipVertex a) ((M).openedTipVertex c)
      ((M).openedTipVertex d) ((M).openedTipVertex e)) :
    ∃ k : N.OriginalBlobArc b, f=coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k ∧
      tipPoint N D b hg hb a ∈ sourceCarrier N D b hg k ∧
      tipPoint N D b hg hb c ∈ sourceCarrier N D b hg k ∧
      tipPoint N D b hg hb d ∈ targetCarrier N D b hg k ∧
      tipPoint N D b hg hb e ∈ targetCarrier N D b hg k

headers.name: two_outgoing_exhaust
headers.header:
private theorem two_outgoing_exhaust {W F : Type*} [Fintype F]
    (G : EdgeGraph W F) (r : W) (hd : G.outDegree r = 2)
    (f k : F) (hfk : f≠k) (hf : G.source f=r) (hk : G.source k=r) :
    ∀ e, G.source e=r → e=f ∨ e=k

headers.name: actual_stem_quartet_false
headers.header:
theorem actual_stem_quartet_false (r : N.RootedCapRootTag b)
    (s : (M).SkeletonEdge) (hs : s.val = Sum.inr (Sum.inr r))
    (a c d e : (M).OpenedTip) (hac : a ≠ c)
    (hq : (OG).OrientedQuartet (Sum.inl s)
      ((M).openedTipVertex a) ((M).openedTipVertex c)
      ((M).openedTipVertex d) ((M).openedTipVertex e)) : False

headers.name: actual_opened_quartet_core_id
headers.header:
theorem actual_opened_quartet_core_id (f : (M).OpenedHybridEdge)
    (a c d e : (M).OpenedTip) (hac : a ≠ c) (hde : d ≠ e)
    (hq : (OG).OrientedQuartet f
      ((M).openedTipVertex a) ((M).openedTipVertex c)
      ((M).openedTipVertex d) ((M).openedTipVertex e)) :
    ∃ k : N.OriginalBlobArc b, f = coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k

headers.name: all_tip_points_on_boundary
headers.header:
theorem all_tip_points_on_boundary {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane}
    (hp : ∀ p : N.BlobPort b, coordinates (D.point (N.originalPortInner b p).val) ∈ C)
    (he : ∀ e : CoreTip N b, coordinates (D.arc e.val.val Nanuq.CapCurves.oneHalf) ∈ C) :
    ∀ t : (M).OpenedTip, tipPoint N D b hg hb t ∈ C

headers.name: actual_nontrivial_tip_boundary
headers.header:
theorem actual_nontrivial_tip_boundary (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ C : Set Schoenflies.Plane, Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
        (coordinates face.outside) = Schoenflies.outside C ∧
      ∀ t : (M).OpenedTip, tipPoint N D b hg hb t ∈ C

headers.name: actual_all_cut_carriers_one_boundary
headers.header:
theorem actual_all_cut_carriers_one_boundary (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ C : Set Schoenflies.Plane, Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Function.Injective (tipPoint N D b hg hb) ∧
      (∀ t : (M).OpenedTip, tipPoint N D b hg hb t ∈ C) ∧
      ∀ k : N.OriginalBlobArc b,
        IsCompact (sourceCarrier N D b hg k) ∧ IsConnected (sourceCarrier N D b hg k) ∧
        IsCompact (targetCarrier N D b hg k) ∧ IsConnected (targetCarrier N D b hg k) ∧
        Disjoint (sourceCarrier N D b hg k) (targetCarrier N D b hg k) ∧
        sourceCarrier N D b hg k ⊆ C ∪ Schoenflies.inside C ∧
        targetCarrier N D b hg k ⊆ C ∪ Schoenflies.inside C

headers.name: side_walk_lift
headers.header:
theorem side_walk_lift (k : E) (a : V) {u v : V}
    (h : G.ReachWithout k u v) : ∀ hu : G.ReachWithout k a u,
    ∀ hv : G.ReachWithout k a v,
    (sideGraph G k a).UReach (fun _ => True) ⟨u,hu⟩ ⟨v,hv⟩

headers.name: side_connected
headers.header:
theorem side_connected (k : E) (a : V) (u v : SideVertex G k a) :
    (sideGraph G k a).UReach (fun _ => True) u v

headers.name: sideCurves_subset
headers.header:
lemma sideCurves_subset (D : PlanarCurves G) (k : E) (a : V) :
    drawing (sideCurves G D k a) ⊆ drawing D

headers.name: point_mem_side_iff
headers.header:
theorem point_mem_side_iff (D : PlanarCurves G) (k : E) (a v : V) :
    D.point v ∈ drawing (sideCurves G D k a) ↔ G.ReachWithout k a v

headers.name: side_of_edge_point
headers.header:
theorem side_of_edge_point (D : PlanarCurves G) (k : E) (a : V)
    (e : E) (he : e ≠ k) (t : unitInterval)
    (hz : D.arc e t ∈ drawing (sideCurves G D k a)) :
    G.ReachWithout k a (G.source e)

headers.name: side_drawings_disjoint
headers.header:
theorem side_drawings_disjoint (D : PlanarCurves G) (k : E) (a c : V)
    (hac : ¬ G.ReachWithout k a c) :
    Disjoint (drawing (sideCurves G D k a)) (drawing (sideCurves G D k c))

headers.name: point_mem_carrier_iff
headers.header:
theorem point_mem_carrier_iff (D : PlanarCurves G) (k : E) (a v : V) :
    coordinates (D.point v) ∈ carrier G D k a ↔ G.ReachWithout k a v

headers.name: carrier_subset
headers.header:
theorem carrier_subset (D : PlanarCurves G) (k : E) (a : V) :
    carrier G D k a ⊆ coordinates '' drawing D

headers.name: carrier_connected
headers.header:
theorem carrier_connected (D : PlanarCurves G) (k : E) (a : V) :
    IsConnected (carrier G D k a)

headers.name: carrier_compact
headers.header:
theorem carrier_compact [Finite V] [Finite E] (D : PlanarCurves G) (k : E) (a : V) :
    IsCompact (carrier G D k a)

headers.name: carriers_disjoint
headers.header:
theorem carriers_disjoint (D : PlanarCurves G) (k : E) (a c : V)
    (hac : ¬ G.ReachWithout k a c) :
    Disjoint (carrier G D k a) (carrier G D k c)

headers.name: terminal_cut_walk_constant
headers.header:
theorem terminal_cut_walk_constant (G : EdgeGraph V E)
    (hin : G.UniqueIncoming) (e : E) (hout : G.outDegree (G.target e)=0)
    {v : V} (h : G.ReachWithout e (G.target e) v) : v=G.target e

headers.name: terminal_oriented_quartet_false
headers.header:
theorem terminal_oriented_quartet_false (G : EdgeGraph V E)
    (hin : G.UniqueIncoming) (e : E) (hout : G.outDegree (G.target e)=0)
    {a b c d : V} (hcd : c≠d) (h : G.OrientedQuartet e a b c d) : False

headers.name: root_leaf_branch_cut_walk
headers.header:
theorem root_leaf_branch_cut_walk (G : EdgeGraph V E)
    (hin : G.UniqueIncoming) (f k : E) (r l : V)
    (hkr : G.source k=r) (hkl : G.target k=l)
    (hroot : ∀ e, G.target e≠r)
    (hexhaust : ∀ e, G.source e=r → e=f ∨ e=k)
    (hleaf : G.outDegree l=0)
    {v : V} (h : G.ReachWithout f r v) : v=r ∨ v=l

headers.name: root_leaf_branch_oriented_quartet_false
headers.header:
theorem root_leaf_branch_oriented_quartet_false (G : EdgeGraph V E)
    (hin : G.UniqueIncoming) (f k : E) (r l : V)
    (hfr : G.source f=r) (hkr : G.source k=r) (hkl : G.target k=l)
    (hroot : ∀ e, G.target e≠r)
    (hexhaust : ∀ e, G.source e=r → e=f ∨ e=k)
    (hleaf : G.outDegree l=0)
    {a b c d : V} (hab : a≠b) (har : a≠r) (hbr : b≠r)
    (h : G.OrientedQuartet f a b c d) : False

headers.name: opened_nontrivial_cut_skeleton
headers.header:
theorem opened_nontrivial_cut_skeleton
    (f : N.OpenedHybridEdge) {a b c d : N.OpenedHybridVertex}
    (hcd : c≠d) (h : (N.openedHybridGraph hleaf).OrientedQuartet f a b c d) :
    ∃ e : N.SkeletonEdge, f=Sum.inl e

headers.name: opened_nontrivial_cut_target_not_tip
headers.header:
theorem opened_nontrivial_cut_target_not_tip
    (f : N.OpenedHybridEdge) {a b c d : N.OpenedHybridVertex}
    (hcd : c≠d) (h : (N.openedHybridGraph hleaf).OrientedQuartet f a b c d)
    (t : N.OpenedTip) :
    (N.openedHybridGraph hleaf).target f ≠ N.openedTipVertex t
